role: Real-world starting room and emotional reference frame.

role: Transition space between bedroom and fantasy world.

role: First touchdown in the Land of Darkness.

role: Bridges the portal landing into the inhabited world.

role: Main orientation node for the whole world.

role: Ground-level arrival point beneath Darkness's house.

role: Entry to the river network and Otto's home berth.

role: Waterborne equivalent of the main hub.

role: Opposite bank and disguise pickup area.

role: Short land corridor from riverbank to guarded path.

role: Guarded threshold before the garden and well district.

role: Garden-adjacent yard centered on the talking well.

role: Sub-surface chamber beneath the well.

role: Bridge crossing from river routes to the park.

role: Optional-feeling recreation pocket beyond the bridge.

role: Utility stop on the river edge.

role: Tiny storage interior with tool/gear staging.

graybox_note: Model as a one-beat interior with clear reach to the key prop spots.

role: Fast downstream route toward the underground spaces.
visual_identity: Narrowing river, speed lines, imminent drop.
graybox_note: Prioritize the feeling of channelized flow and a committed direction of travel.

role: Recovery basin after the waterfall plunge.

role: Subterranean continuation of the river route.

role: Returns underground travel to the surface.

role: Messier east-side surface patch that helps spatially round out the shorelands.

role: Front door to the mine network and King's home track.

role: Small clue-focused side chamber.

role: Mine-side access to the house's hidden back route.

role: Transition from upper mines into lower-mine routes.

role: Main lower-mine loop with multiple possible branch reads.
